activities.title: Check in to hotel
activities.notes: Drop bags, rest after long flight

activities.title: Shinjuku Omoide Yokocho (Memory Lane)
activities.notes: Tiny yakitori alleyway, grab skewers and beer

activities.title: Shinjuku by night stroll
activities.notes: Golden Gai has tiny themed bars, very Japan

activities.title: Senso-ji Temple at dawn
activities.notes: Taisho-era streets — this is what Demon Slayer is modeled on. Go before crowds at 7am.

activities.title: Nakamise Shopping Street breakfast & shopping
activities.notes: Try ningyo-yaki (character cakes) and melon bread

activities.title: Akihabara — anime & manga district
activities.notes: Animate, Mandarake, Yodobashi Camera. Demon Slayer, Naruto, Bleach merch everywhere.

activities.title: Naruto Museum Tokyo
activities.notes: Full Naruto & Boruto exhibition

activities.title: TeamLab Planets
activities.notes: BOOK IN ADVANCE — always sells out. Immersive digital art.

activities.title: Tsukiji Outer Market breakfast
activities.notes: Best tamagoyaki, sushi, and tuna on skewers in the city

activities.title: Harajuku & Takeshita Street
activities.notes: Pop culture fashion, crepes, cosplay — your wife will love this

activities.title: Meiji Jingu Shrine
activities.notes: Peaceful forested shrine in the middle of the city. Stunning in autumn.

activities.title: Shibuya Crossing at golden hour
activities.notes: Watch from Starbucks above or just join the crossing — do both

activities.title: Shibuya dinner & drinks
activities.notes: Try an izakaya — order yakitori, edamame, karaage and draft beer

days.theme: Fuji-Q Hidden Leaf Village (Naruto) + Mt. Fuji Views

activities.title: Train from Shinjuku to Fuji-Q Highland
activities.notes: ~2 hours. Take Fujikyu Railway from Otsuki.

activities.title: NARUTO×BORUTO FUJI Hidden Leaf Village
activities.notes: BOOK IN ADVANCE. Walk through Konoha, Hokage Rock photo, Ichiraku Ramen restaurant, ninja games

activities.title: Lake Kawaguchi — Mt. Fuji reflection
activities.notes: Autumn foliage + Fuji reflection in the lake. October is prime. Best photo spot: north shore.

activities.title: Check in near Kawaguchiko
activities.notes: Stay near the lake for sunrise Fuji views tomorrow morning

activities.title: Sunrise at Chureito Pagoda
activities.notes: The iconic shot — red pagoda with Mt. Fuji behind. Climb 400 steps. Worth every step.

activities.title: Kawaguchiko Maple Corridor
activities.notes: Peak autumn foliage tunnel of maple trees — October is perfect timing

activities.title: Travel to Hakone by Romancecar
activities.notes: Odakyu Romancecar — scenic mountain train. ~1.5 hours.

activities.title: Check in to ryokan
activities.notes: Private hinoki wood onsen on your terrace. Includes dinner + breakfast.

activities.title: Kaiseki dinner at ryokan
activities.notes: Included with ryokan. Multi-course traditional Japanese dinner. Wear yukata.

activities.title: Private onsen morning soak
activities.notes: Included. Best time is early morning — cool air, hot spring, mountain silence.

activities.title: Hakone Open Air Museum
activities.notes: Outdoor sculpture park with Picasso pavilion. Beautiful in autumn foliage.

activities.title: Hakone Ropeway over Owakudani
activities.notes: Cable car over active volcanic crater. Try the black egg (kuro-tamago) — boiled in sulfur springs.

activities.title: Lake Ashi boat cruise with Fuji view
activities.notes: Pirate ship cruise. On clear days Mt. Fuji visible from the lake.

activities.title: Second night at ryokan
activities.notes: Night 2. Included dinner again. Try the outdoor communal bath this evening.

activities.title: Shinkansen Hakone → Kyoto
activities.notes: Covered by JR Pass. ~2.5 hours on the Hikari. Arrive in time for lunch.

activities.title: Nishiki Market food walk
activities.notes: Kyoto's Kitchen. 100+ stalls — try tofu skewers, fresh yuba, pickles, tamagoyaki.

activities.title: Check in to Gion area hotel
activities.notes: Stay in Gion — walking distance to everything

activities.title: Gion district at dusk — Demon Slayer streets
activities.notes: The preserved Taisho-era machiya townhouses ARE Demon Slayer's world. Best at dusk. Geisha sightings possible.

activities.title: Fushimi Inari at dawn
activities.notes: 1,000 torii gates on a forested mountain. Referenced throughout Demon Slayer. No crowds at 6:30am.

activities.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
activities.notes: Iconic bamboo forest — go before 10am. Pair with Tenryu-ji garden next door.

activities.title: Torokko Romantic Train
activities.notes: Old scenic train through the Hozugawa gorge. Autumn leaves in October — stunning.

activities.title: Philosopher's Path walk
activities.notes: 2km canal-side path lined with maple trees. October foliage is spectacular.

activities.title: Kaiseki dinner in Kyoto
activities.notes: Splurge night — Kyoto kaiseki is world-class. Book via Tabelog or Omakase.

activities.title: Rurikō-in Temple — autumn leaf reflection
activities.notes: MUST BOOK IN ADVANCE — only open in autumn. Autumn leaves reflected in polished wooden floor. One of the most photographed scenes in Japan.

activities.title: Train to Nara (day trip)
activities.notes: 45 min on JR Nara line. Covered by JR Pass.

activities.title: Nara Park deer + Todai-ji Temple
activities.notes: 1,200 free-roaming deer. Todai-ji houses the world's largest bronze Buddha. Deer bow if you bow back.

activities.title: Return to Kyoto + Pontocho dinner
activities.notes: Narrow lantern-lit alley of restaurants. Request a riverside terrace seat (kawayuka) — magical in October.

days.theme: Travel to Osaka + Dotonbori Food Crawl

activities.title: Shinkansen Kyoto → Osaka
activities.notes: 13 minutes on the Shinkansen. Covered by JR Pass.

activities.title: Check in to Osaka hotel
activities.notes: Stay near Namba — walking distance to Dotonbori and everything

activities.title: Kuromon Market lunch
activities.notes: Osaka's Kitchen. Fresh seafood, wagyu skewers, fugu. Eat your way through.

activities.title: Osaka Castle + autumn foliage
activities.notes: Historic castle with city views from the top. Maple trees in the park turn red in October.

activities.title: Dotonbori food crawl
activities.notes: Takoyaki at Aizuya, okonomiyaki at Mizuno, ramen at Kinryu. Walk the neon canal strip.

activities.title: Shinsekai — retro Osaka district
activities.notes: Old-school retro neighbourhood — 1950s Japan vibes. Try kushikatsu (deep-fried skewers).

activities.title: Day trip to Kurashiki (hidden gem)
activities.notes: 1.5hr train from Osaka. Canal-side willow trees, white-walled storehouses — old Japan without the crowds. Ohara Museum of Art is world-class.

activities.title: Return to Osaka — Amerikamura
activities.notes: Osaka's streetwear and youth culture district. Like Harajuku but edgier.

activities.title: Final dinner — Osaka omakase or wagyu
activities.notes: Last big meal — go for wagyu beef or a small omakase counter. Osaka has incredible value.

activities.title: Morning stroll — Sumiyoshi Taisha Shrine
activities.notes: One of Japan's oldest shrines, peaceful and beautiful. Hidden gem even in Osaka.

activities.title: Umeda Sky Building — floating garden observatory
activities.notes: 360° views from the rooftop ring. Retro underground shopping street below (Takimi-koji) is worth a wander.

activities.title: Namba Parks + shopping
activities.notes: Rooftop garden mall. Good for souvenirs, Japanese cosmetics, and a break from the heat.

activities.title: Hozenji Yokocho dinner
activities.notes: Atmospheric moss-covered alley with traditional restaurants. The tiny Fudo-Myoo shrine is tucked inside — locals splash water on the statue for good luck.

days.theme: Universal Studios Japan (Nintendo World + Harry Potter)

activities.title: Universal Studios Japan — full day
activities.notes: BOOK IN ADVANCE. Nintendo World (Mario Kart ride, wristband power-ups), Wizarding World of Harry Potter, and Minion Park. Get the Express Pass for Nintendo World — lines can be 3 hours.

activities.title: Post-USJ dinner at Namba ramen street
activities.notes: Feet will be tired — grab a bowl of rich tonkotsu ramen near the hotel and call it a night.

activities.title: Final konbini breakfast + souvenir shopping
activities.notes: Don Quijote for last-minute gifts. Kit Kat flavors, sake, matcha snacks for home.

activities.title: Haruka Express to Kansai Airport
activities.notes: Haruka Limited Express, ~80 min. Fly home from KIX or return to Tokyo (NRT) depending on your ticket.
